source_refs.note: Book p. 287: 11.1.1 Scalar Function, definition and the example f(t) = 3t + 2cos t

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum "scalar function" ko achhi tarah samjhenge, kyun ke vector function samajhne ke liye pehle yeh samajhna zaroori hai ke scalar function kya hota hai. Asal mein aap Grade XI se jo functions parh rahe hain, woh sab scalar functions hi the; bas un ka naam aaj rakha ja raha hai.

Kitab ki definition: scalar function woh function hai jo apne domain ke har point ko sirf ek real number (yani ek scalar) deta hai. Ise ek aisa rule samjhiye jo space mein kisi jagah ko ek value de deta hai, jaise kisi khaas point par temperature naapna. Thermometer kisi jagah rakhein to woh sirf ek number batata hai, maslan 32 degree; woh koi simt (direction) nahin batata.

Mathematical zaban mein: agar function \(f(t)\) ke domain mein scalar variable \(t\) ki har value ke liye ek, aur sirf ek, scalar \(f\) milta hai, to \(f\) ko \(t\) ka scalar function kehte hain. Real-valued function (jis ki value real number ho) ko hi aam tor par scalar function kaha jata hai. Kitab ki misaal: \(f(t) = 3t + 2\cos t\) ek scalar function hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
"Scalar" ka matlab hai aisi miqdar jis ka sirf size ho, simt na ho: mass, time, temperature, speed, lambai. Scalar function woh hai jis ka OUTPUT aisa ek real number ho.
Ab \(f(t) = 3t + 2\cos t\) ko neeche table mein check karte hain. \(t\) jo bhi rakhein, jawab mein ek hi real number aata hai. Jawab mein koi direction nahin, is liye \(f\) scalar function hai.

blocks.caption: Hamara table: har input t par sirf ek real number

blocks.text: Table kaise bana, ek ek kar ke dekhte hain. \(t = 0\) par \(\cos 0 = 1\), to \(f(0) = 0 + 2 = 2\). \(t = \pi/2\) par \(\cos(\pi/2) = 0\), to sirf \(3\pi/2\) bachta hai. \(t = \pi\) par \(\cos\pi = -1\), to \(f(\pi) = 3\pi - 2\). Har dafa ek input, ek output. Yahi scalar function ki pehchaan hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Khud sochiye: \(g(t) = t^{2} - 1\) scalar function hai ya nahin? Haan, kyun ke \(t = 2\) par \(g(2) = 3\), sirf ek number. Aur rozmarra zindagi mein: kisi shehar ka har ghante ka temperature, bijli ka bill har mahine ke units ke hisaab se, ya gari ki speed time ke saath: yeh sab scalar functions hain.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Scalar function pehchaanne ke liye sirf output ko dekhiye. Agar jawab ek real number hai, us mein \(\hat{i}, \hat{j}, \hat{k}\) nahin, aur angle brackets \(\langle\ \rangle\) bhi nahin, to scalar function hai. Input kitne hain, is se farq nahin parta: space mein kisi point par temperature \(T(x, y, z)\) ke teen inputs hain, phir bhi woh scalar function hai (11.3.1 mein yeh misaal aayegi).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Scalar function domain ke har point ko sirf ek real number (scalar) deta hai.
2. Agar \(t\) ki har value par ek unique scalar \(f\) mile, to \(f\) ko \(t\) ka scalar function kehte hain.
3. Real-valued function = scalar function; kitab ki misaal \(f(t) = 3t + 2\cos t\).
4. Kisi point par temperature scalar function ki sab se aasan misaal hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Zyada inputs dekh kar function ko "vector" keh dena: scalar ya vector ka faisla sirf output se hota hai.
2. Speed aur velocity ko ek samajhna: speed sirf number hai (scalar), velocity number + direction hai (vector).
3. \(\cos t\) mein degrees lagana: radians mein \(\cos 0 = 1\) aur \(\cos\pi = -1\).
